summary: The actual inactive constructor creates and validates UID32768 private files. Running its full synthetic fixture as an ordinary nonroot host user refuses at ownership; replacing the owner predicate would bypass the production path under test. The maintained source launcher instead runs the existing focused console in an immutable SDK401 disposable container with read-only recursive source, bounded tmpfs/output/time/resources, no execution network and only CHOWN/DAC_OVERRIDE/FOWNER. The ordinary nonroot source suite retains its remaining coverage. Cleanup independently authenticates exact CID/name/image, owner label, command, mounts/propagation, namespaces, nonprivileged/no-device scope, capabilities/security and limits immediately before removal; file recovery alone supplies no removal authority, and unreadable/mismatched scope remains unknown. This test namespace and its synthetic external responses establish source control flow only. They do not resolve production mapped-UID/profile, delayed native capability, captured-result custody, provider, cold-image or installed acceptance. Missing Docker and unsupported mount/API behavior refuse rather than skipping the source gate.
title: Inactive source tests preserve real guest ownership in a bounded namespace
